spec.name: M7.Factorized.pair_count
spec.statement: ∀ (S T : Type) [Fintype S] [Fintype T] (left : S → Prop) (right : T → Prop), M7.Factorized.count (fun p : S × T => left p.1 ∧ right p.2) = M7.Factorized.count left * M7.Factorized.count right
spec.guidance: Identify filtered product with product of the two filtered univs by Finset.ext; use Finset.card_product. Explicit mem_filter rewrites avoid stalled simp under classical local deciders. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M7.Factorized.numerator_record_card
spec.statement: ∀ (U S T : Type) [Fintype U] [Fintype S] [Fintype T] (sector : U → Prop) (left : U → S → Prop) (right : U → T → Prop), M7.Factorized.numerator sector left right = (M7.Factorized.records sector left right).card
spec.guidance: Split finite triple cardinality into sum over U and filtered pair cardinality. Equivalently rewrite card as sum of indicators, Fintype.sum_prod_type, and distribute separate sums. Sector indicator is counted once. No group action assumed. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M7.Factorized.exact_target_card
spec.statement: ∀ (U S T : Type) [Fintype U] [Fintype S] [Fintype T], ∀ (X Y : Type) (leftImage : U → S → X) (rightImage : U → T → Y) (x : X) (y : Y), M7.Factorized.exactTargetNumerator leftImage rightImage x y = M7.Factorized.count (fun r : U × S × T => leftImage r.1 r.2.1 = x ∧ rightImage r.1 r.2.2 = y)
spec.guidance: Specialize numerator_record_card with sector True. This is an exact-target record count, not yet an actual group-stabilizer theorem; all records including redundant images remain counted. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M7.Factorized.left_partition
spec.statement: ∀ (U S T : Type) [Fintype U] [Fintype S] [Fintype T] (sector : U → Prop) (left : U → S → Prop) (right : U → T → Prop), ∀ test : U → S → Bool, M7.Factorized.numerator sector left right = M7.Factorized.numerator sector (fun u s => left u s ∧ test u s = false) right + M7.Factorized.numerator sector (fun u s => left u s ∧ test u s = true) right
spec.guidance: Partition records by the Boolean test of the left record, or split count(left u) into its false/true filters and distribute. Exactly two disjoint exhaustive children, no extra prefix assumptions. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M7.Factorized.right_partition
spec.statement: ∀ (U S T : Type) [Fintype U] [Fintype S] [Fintype T] (sector : U → Prop) (left : U → S → Prop) (right : U → T → Prop), ∀ test : U → T → Bool, M7.Factorized.numerator sector left right = M7.Factorized.numerator sector left (fun u t => right u t ∧ test u t = false) + M7.Factorized.numerator sector left (fun u t => right u t ∧ test u t = true)
spec.guidance: Same exact two-child partition on the right record. Use actual finite indicators or filtered-card partition. No orbit normalization is performed here. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M7.Factorized.exact_target_positive
spec.statement: ∀ (U S T : Type) [Fintype U] [Fintype S] [Fintype T], ∀ (X Y : Type) (leftImage : U → S → X) (rightImage : U → T → Y) (x : X) (y : Y), (0 < M7.Factorized.exactTargetNumerator leftImage rightImage x y ↔ ∃ (u : U) (s : S) (t : T), leftImage u s = x ∧ rightImage u t = y)
spec.guidance: Use exact_target_card and Finset.card_pos, unfold count and extract the triple witness. Later actual identity action discharges this existence for stabilizer positivity. Return tactic lines only without leading by.
